summary: Dynamic API Key Manager (Fernet-encrypted, DB-backed) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASSED (list/PUT/reveal/DELETE, encryption-at-rest as Fernet gAAAA ciphertext, source=db switch, masking with last-4, .env fallback restore, 401 without token, 400 on empty value, 404 on unknown key, audit trail for api_key_updated/revealed/deleted). Frontend: admin panel /admin/configuracion → 'API Keys' tab renders with the 'Gestión de API Keys en vivo' banner, 9 grouped service cards, correct '.env (archivo)' (8) and 'Base de Datos' (2 — Lob + OpenAI existing overrides) badges. Live rotation flow works: typed value in TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN input → Guardar → success message 'aplicada en vivo' shown → badge switched to 'Base de Datos' → eye/reveal returned plaintext → trash icon (with confirm dialog) deleted override → badge reverted. Regression: Empresa, Stripe, Procesadores de Pago tabs all load without errors. Cleanup verified: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN now source='missing' in DB, LOB_API_KEY untouched (source=db, masked ends 'e1de').
critical_code_review_comments: api_keys_router.py is clean, well-documented, and follows existing patterns from vault_router (encrypt/decrypt/mask/_audit reuse — DRY compliant).
load_db_keys_into_env() runs sync (pymongo) at boot BEFORE async routers import → correct pattern for env injection.
_ORIGINAL_ENV snapshot taken at import-time is the right approach to remember .env fallbacks after DB override.
ApiKeys.tsx (240 lines) is compact and focused; secret inputs are type='password' and reveals are audited server-side.

One minor observation (non-blocking): fetchKeys() useCallback dependency array is empty but references headers() from props — works because headers is stable, but adding [headers] would be more idiomatic.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Test PUT wrote TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN='test_token_abc123' then DELETE cleaned it up. Also frontend test wrote 'live_test_zzz9999' and deleted it. Final DB state: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN not present in admin_config.keys (source='missing'). LOB_API_KEY untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend under test is ross-house-backend on port 8002 (uvicorn, cwd /app/ross-house-backend, logs /tmp/rhr_backend.log). Next.js is on 3001 (yarn dev, logs /tmp/next_dev.log). Auth via POST /api/public/marketplace-login (yoandyross@gmail.com/admin123) returns Bearer token without OTP. For UI login inject cookies rhr_admin_token=<jwt> and rhr_admin_user=<user-json> on domain localhost. Mongo DB name is 'taxportal'. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_api_keys_manager.py covers full CRUD + at-rest encryption + audit trail — safe to re-run.
